description: Intent i007 (branch=unchecked-tb-deref, snapshot s02) complete. One credible finding, high confidence: s02:drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c:421-431, hwsim_new_edge_nl (MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE doit, registered at 605-610 with .flags = GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM and .validate = GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT|GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_DUMP). Untrusted source: attacker-crafted generic-netlink attribute set. Violated invariant: the only presence guard (lines 421-423, literal quote in artifact) joins the two negated presence tests with && instead of ||, so it rejects only when BOTH MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID and MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE are absent; the family nla_policy (lines 579-583) only types the slots ({ .type = NLA_U32 } at 580, { .type = NLA_NESTED } at 581) and marks neither required, so genl core enforces no presence — exactly this branch's "no presence guard and no policy-required entry covers the exact attribute index" case. Unsafe uses: line 425 passes info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE] (NULL when the message supplies RADIO_ID and omits RADIO_EDGE) as the nesting attribute to nla_parse_nested_deprecated(), which dereferences it via nla_len()/nla_data() inside the parser -> NULL-pointer oops; line 431 nla_get_u32(info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID]) (NULL when only RADIO_EDGE is supplied) is an unchecked read through a NULL slot. Counterevidence: sibling handlers in the same file are fixed in this snapshot — hwsim_set_edge_lqi uses || at 531-533 with both inner edge attrs checked at 538-540 (verified line-by-line), and the seed function hwsim_del_edge_nl already uses || (excluded by rule); parsed IDs feed only hwsim_get_radio_by_id lookups, so no OOB length/index consumption was identified. Artifact: /mnt/.../agent-state/findings/i007.json (snapshots_checked=["s02"], 1 finding, 7 candidates — 2 reported here/cross-referenced from the sibling i009 rtnl branch (i40e_main.c:12774, ice_main.c:6651 missing !br_spec guard), 4 safe (set_edge_lqi, del_edge_nl, nl80211.c:6553 at-least-one AID idiom, plus enumerated others), 6 concrete limitations). Bounded negative evidence: the generic-netlink direct-slot-deref file list (19 files across net/ and drivers/) was enumerated by grep but, per the finalize directive, only mac802154_hwsim.c and nl80211.c:6553 were deep-read in this session — the remainder plus rtnl_link_ops changelink handlers, net/sched, net/dcb, net/decnet, net/mpls doit surfaces, and nft_tunnel.c (structurally identical && guard known from s01 evidence but unexamined at exact s02 lines) remain unexamined; no runtime reproducer was possible (read-only tree, no .config); reachability requires mac802154_hwsim loaded and CAP_NET_ADMIN in the sender's user namespace; impact characterized as local DoS (NULL-pointer dereference oops), no privilege escalation demonstrated. Note the same defect was also reported for this snapshot under the and-presence-guard branch (fact f006); this finding records it from the unchecked-tb-deref perspective per this intent's branch definition.
